logp.method_description: The octanol:water partition coefficient of Au(BzTMX)2 was determined by measuring the logP using a shake flask method, according to The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (the OECD),1981 [35]. In brief, deionized water and n-octanol (Merck KGaA, Germany) were presaturated for 24 h under stirring. Au(BzTMX)2 stock-solution was prepared in pre-saturated water at 0.047 mmol/L-1. Subsequently, the stock solution and pre-saturated n-octanol were added to a conical flask (Falcon-type) at a 1:1 ratio (VF = 15 mL) and kept shaking for 2 h in a horizontal shaker, then centrifuged at 40×g for 5 min to separate phases. Aliquots of the stock solution and the aqueous phase passed through an acid opening in a 50 % aqua regia solution and calcined in a muffle at 500 °C for 20 min. After this step, the solids were diluted in 1 % aqua regia until VF = 15 mL and sent for analysis in ICP-OES, which is calibrated with an Au (Merck KGaA) standard solution. The formula Coctanol = Ctotal - Cwater was adopted to calculate the concentration in octanol phase and log Coctanol/Cwater to obtain LogP.
